subject: english
stem: Ben wanted the puppy to enter its carrier. Food did not work, so he placed its favorite blanket inside. The puppy walked in. Which action finally serves the goal successfully?
options: putting the blanket in the carrier
removing all food from the house
closing the carrier before the puppy enters

optionRationales.reason: teaching the puppy to read：未提。
putting the blanket in the carrier：blanket 後 puppy walked in，目標達成。
removing all food from the house：未提 all food。
closing the carrier before the puppy enters：未提且會阻止。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「人物的目標由需求或意圖建立，後續行動與反應顯示是否持續或改變」可推出 putting the blanket in the carrier；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 putting the blanket in the carrier 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
